$generated.description: A marketing feature grid: an optional {it,en} heading (eyebrow?/title?/subtitle?) over items[] of { icon, title, description }; icon is a name from an owned enum resolved internally to a lucide glyph, never raw code; all text is {it,en}.

a11y: Each item's icon is decorative: it is rendered aria-hidden so a screen reader never announces a bare glyph name; the item's meaning is carried entirely by its visible {it,en} title text.

One heading level per tier with a clean order: the optional section title is a heading (h2) and each item title is the heading one level below it (h3); the eyebrow is decorative label text, not a heading.
Meaning is never carried by colour or icon alone: every feature is named by its title and described by its description text, legible independent of the accent tint.

Contrast holds in both dark and light: text uses foreground/muted-foreground and the accent surfaces use the accent-driven tokens, all themed in :root and .dark, so axe A/AA stays clean in both themes.
forbidden: No raw HTML/code or SVG string in any prop and no dangerouslySetInnerHTML: text is {it,en} plain strings and icon is a name-token from the owned enum resolved internally to a lucide component, never markup or a ReactNode/children icon slot.
No per-feature link/CTA/href: an item exposes exactly icon + title + description; links and CTAs belong to other components.

No hardcoded hue or hex/oklch literal: colour comes only from the accent-driven and semantic tokens (text-foreground / text-muted-foreground / border-border / bg-card / --accent-ink / --acc-dim / --acc-line), never a fixed colour value.
No unknown icon name: an icon outside the curated enum is refused at the Zod boundary as InvalidComponentPropsError, never rendered as raw SVG or crashed on.
